question: Does either remaining existing state-dependent turn-economy relic expose a naturally owned, reproducible, inactive, viable and separately identifiable Duskblade route strongly enough to justify exact mediator telemetry before any causal ablation row?
competingOptions: freeze the first complete pass in the preregistered state-simplicity order for observation-only exact telemetry and current-path identity proof
close the complete existing turn-state action-economy family and continue with another materially different mechanism inside issue #421
record an inconclusive result at the frozen cap

sourceFilter.selectionRule: From exact current-main natural relic pools, after removing unconditional/start-turn scalars and the closed cadence, Shatter, Ward, Kindle and non-final-death families, select every remaining relic whose authored payoff depends on mutable state reset or retained at a turn boundary. Freeze all results before ownership or outcome support is read.

definition.name: Duskmirror
definition.text: The first card you play each turn costs 0.

candidates.state: The existing combat-scoped first_card_played boolean is reset false at each player turn and becomes true after the first played card.
candidates.mediator: While the relic is owned and first_card_played is false, the first card's effective cost is exactly zero.
candidates.authoredPayoff: Only the exact printed Energy cost of that first card is saved. No card definition, draw, damage, Ward, Facet, status, reward, score or RNG rule changes.
candidates.upperOpportunity: At least one positive-printed-cost card is played anywhere in the run. Turn position and saved Energy are intentionally not inferred.
candidates.mechanisticJustification: This is an existing binary within-turn sequencing state, materially different from play-count cadence, death chain, Shatter threshold, setup-to-next-Attack and acquisition preference.

definition.name: Frozen Core
definition.text: Unspent Energy carries over between turns.

candidates.state: At player-turn start, the existing numeric Energy balance is retained before normal turn Energy is added instead of reset to zero.
candidates.mediator: A positive unspent Energy balance crosses a turn boundary while the relic is already owned and can fund later cards.
candidates.authoredPayoff: Only the exact unspent Energy amount is retained. No new Energy, card definition, draw, damage, Ward, Facet, status, reward, score or RNG rule changes.
candidates.upperOpportunity: At least one fight lasts two or more turns. Unspent Energy and later use are intentionally not inferred.
candidates.mechanisticJustification: This is an existing numeric turn-transition reservoir, materially different from Duskmirror's one-bit first-card discount and all closed event/cadence mechanisms.

selectionJustification: The order is frozen by native state simplicity before support: Duskmirror uses one already-maintained boolean and one cost branch; Frozen Core preserves a numeric reservoir across turns. At most the first complete pass receives telemetry authority; the candidates are never combined.
claimBoundary: Final ownership plus a permissive opportunity can only overstate exposure. It cannot establish acquisition timing, first-card position, saved or carried Energy, later resource use, causal complementarity, package admission or product quality.
closedDirections: Reaper's Bell and every non-final-death action-economy variant
Executioner's Seal and every added Attack/card cadence relic
reward-Attack overchip, generic Shatter flow, Crown, reseam and heavy-Attack relay
one-bit and Power-cycle setup, Honing repeat, Ward, Kindle, Afterimage and Cracked
changing either relic's effect, rarity, score, offer or pool gate
combining the two relics or adding Waning Moon/context cells

duskmirrorFirstCardPayoff.current: Existing first-card effective cost of zero while Duskmirror is owned.
duskmirrorFirstCardPayoff.status: Fixed observational mechanism; not varied and not a causal estimand.

frozenCoreCarryPayoff.current: Existing retention of unspent Energy across a player-turn boundary while Frozen Core is owned.
frozenCoreCarryPayoff.status: Separate fixed observational mechanism; not varied and not combined with Duskmirror.

scorelinePayoff.current: Exact frozen Scoreline payoff and Faultline path.

afterimagePayoff.current: Exact frozen Afterimage payoff and Guarded Strike path.
afterimagePayoff.status: Separate causal factor fixed independently from Scoreline and both turn-state mechanisms.

designMatrix.kind: two separate mechanism blocks over one immutable observational cell; not a factorial
designMatrix.aliasStructure: Both blocks reuse the same rows but are separate necessary-capacity estimands. Their final-ownership aliases are reported independently; no independence, interaction or joint effect is inferred.
designMatrix.expansionRule: At most the first passing block may add identity-safe telemetry. No joint cell is authorised. A later causal factor, levels, equal-cohort CRN contrast and interference cells require their own preregistration before rows.

capacityDefinitions.ownerRow: The final whole-run relic inventory contains the candidate relic; this can post-date earlier opportunities and therefore only overstates exposure.
capacityDefinitions.opportunityRowDuskmirror: At least one positive-printed-cost card is played anywhere in the run.
capacityDefinitions.opportunityRowFrozenCore: At least one fight lasts two or more turns.
capacityDefinitions.potentialActiveRow: Both ownerRow and the candidate's opportunity row are true.
capacityDefinitions.robustOwnerPolicy: At least two of four frozen rows are owner rows.
capacityDefinitions.opportunityPolicy: At least two of four frozen rows contain the candidate's opportunity.
capacityDefinitions.potentialActivePolicy: At least two of four frozen rows are potential-active.
capacityDefinitions.exactInactivePolicy: None of four frozen rows is potential-active.
capacityDefinitions.ambiguousPolicy: Exactly one of four frozen rows is potential-active.
capacityDefinitions.anyAcquiredPolicy: At least one frozen row ends with the candidate relic.
capacityDefinitions.viablePotentialActivePolicy: The policy is potential-active and has at least one potential-active Vow-5 row whose whole-run outcome is win.
capacityDefinitions.scorelineRoutePolicy: At least two of four frozen rows play Chisel before a later Faultline in the same fight.
capacityDefinitions.afterimageRoutePolicy: At least two of four frozen rows record positive afterimageGuardDamage.
capacityDefinitions.candidateOnlyPolicy: Potential-active for the candidate but not active for the named anchor.
capacityDefinitions.anchorOnlyPolicy: Active for the named anchor but not potential-active for the candidate.

interactionAndAlias.mechanisticInteractions: None are estimated. Duskmirror, Frozen Core, Scoreline and Afterimage remain four distinct fixed mechanisms; this is not the old four-factor design and no factor varies.
interactionAndAlias.upperBoundAlias: Final ownership is aliased with unknown acquisition time. Duskmirror opportunity is aliased with unknown turn position and saved Energy; Frozen Core opportunity is aliased with unknown unspent Energy and later use. Every alias can only overstate activation.
interactionAndAlias.sharedInterferenceAnchors: Each block receives separate candidate-only, anchor-only and Jaccard checks against the same exact Scoreline and Afterimage policy identities. No cross-candidate or joint cell exists.
interactionAndAlias.staging: A pass supports only observation-only path/mediator telemetry. No whole-run causal endpoint is supported until every contrast shares frozen policies, seeds, baseline, estimator and stop rule.

baseline.name: current-main root-551 Duskblade Vow-5 natural reward/economy rectangle

traceEvidence.name: identity-proved explicit-current arm from the Momentum preference CRN rectangle
traceEvidence.identityRule: After trace and row-label fields are removed, every current row must exactly equal its cached baseline path, RNG, policy and result before either candidate count is read.

scoreline.definition: Chisel precedes a later Faultline in the same fight in at least two of four rows.

afterimage.definition: Positive afterimageGuardDamage is recorded in at least two of four rows.

cohort.identity: Both mechanism blocks and both shared anchors reuse the exact complete current-main first-look rectangle. No policy or seed is added, removed, selected or replaced.

estimands.unit: Policy identity with the frozen two-of-four robustness rule.
estimands.sourceCompleteness: Exact current-main turn-state hooks, relic definitions, natural rare-pool membership and pool gates for both candidates.
estimands.primary: For each block, exact robust-owner, opportunity, potential-active, exact-inactive and ambiguous policy counts and identities under its permissive upper bound.
estimands.reachability: Exact policies with any final candidate acquisition and robust final ownership.
estimands.viability: Exact potential-active policies with at least one potential-active winning Vow-5 row.
estimands.separation: Separate exact candidate-only, anchor-only, cross-active and Jaccard statistics against frozen Scoreline and Afterimage policy identities.
estimands.notEstimated: No acquisition time, first-card position, saved Energy, carried Energy, post-mediator use, causal payoff, interaction, duration, RandomBuild, Ashwarden, detector, protected-seed or product effect is estimated.

estimator.method: Deterministic current-main source assertions, exact opportunity predicates and exact policy-set arithmetic.
estimator.model: None. No bootstrap, fitted model, optimiser, ML or RL component is used.
estimator.firstLook: Both exhaustive source-defined candidates are evaluated once from the same immutable trace. No relic, opportunity, threshold, selection order or cohort changes after counts are visible.
estimator.stopping: Freeze at most the first complete pass in the state-simplicity order for exact telemetry; close the family when neither passes; otherwise record inconclusive only at the numeric cap.

gates.provenance: The 16 active/inactive/ownership/opportunity and eight viability/two-sided-separation minima reuse the frozen 64-policy first-look scale. Both anchors use the same 0.75 Jaccard ceiling, and one fault is the immutable cached baseline.

decisionRules.success: The first candidate in the frozen state-simplicity order whose source, owner-reachability, opportunity, potential-active, inactive, viability, separate Scoreline/Afterimage interference and reliability gates all pass is selected; a later passing candidate receives no authority.
decisionRules.successAuthority: For the selected candidate only, add observation-only acquisition time and exact mediator/use telemetry: first-card identity, printed/effective cost, saved Energy and later same-turn spend for Duskmirror; or turn-start pre-Energy, carried Energy and later spend for Frozen Core. Prove omitted/current path, RNG, policy and result identity on the frozen cohort before any new simulator row. Do not vary a payoff, combine candidates, add context cells or change relic definitions/acquisition.
decisionRules.futility: Neither candidate passes every frozen gate.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close the complete existing turn-state action-economy family and continue with the next materially different source- and evidence-backed structural mechanism inside issue #421. Do not change opportunity predicates, combine relics, add Waning Moon, alter scores/rarities/offers or hand-pick a card carrier.
decisionRules.inconclusive: The current-main source, immutable trace or deterministic screen cannot produce a complete decision before the numeric wall-time cap.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Record the inconclusive result at the cap without telemetry, simulator spend, trace extension, a causal factor or protected seeds.

methodBoundary: Deterministic Python owns source selection, source assertions, trace validation, block-specific capacity classification, frozen-order selection and stop/go. Existing exact traces are immutable input. No model context, human label, ML, RL, optimiser or adaptive candidate iteration enters the decision.
